newsitem.title: USA: SPX acquires technical service provider.
newsitem.headline: SPX acquires technical service provider.

text.p: SPX Corp said Tuesday it has agreed to purchase A.R. Brasch Marketing Inc, which develops technical service and training for vehicle manufacturers, for an unisclosed amount.

A.R. Brasch, of Allen Park, Mich., has annual sales approaching $10 million, SPX said. Following completion of the purchase, A.R. Brasch will become part of SPX's OE Tool and Equipment Group in Warren, Mich.
Thomas Riordan, president of the OE Tool and Equipment Group, said the acquisition will help SPX meet its committments to support vehicle manufacturers' service readiness activities.

"The addition of Brasch's capabilities enables us to broaden our bundle of value-added services and it fits perfectly with our redefined strategic intent of providing universal service solutions to the global motor vehicle industry," he said. "The acquisition also supports the strategy of vehicle manufacturers to outsource these critical, but non-core activities."
